router.about: 150 labelled customer messages in 9 categories, 3 runs per router, judged on what the customer actually gets

rag.about: 41 policy questions (4 deliberately unanswerable), deterministic checks, no LLM judge

tool.about: 20 multi-turn conversations x 3 runs through the real router, LLM, safety layer and mock airline; judged on the final booking state

fixes.title: Opening reply for a disrupted flight
fixes.problem: An LLM-written intro took 15.7 s of the request and the guardrail discarded it every time
fixes.fix: Intro written by code from the booking

fixes.title: Cancel lookalikes
fixes.problem: Questions like 'what happens if I cancel?' were routed as cancellations
fixes.fix: Cancel only on a clear instruction; exception demands go to a person

fixes.title: Exception demands
fixes.problem: 'Refund me or I'll sue' reached a person only when it was misrouted
fixes.fix: Demanding an exception escalates on any route

fixes.title: Wrong cancel decisions
fixes.problem: About 5 per run on the 150-case set (all stopped by the YES step)
fixes.fix: Same routing fix, measured on the full benchmark

fixes.title: Policy answers
fixes.problem: The right section ranked 4th-5th for two questions, so the model refused
fixes.fix: Top 5 sections and low reasoning effort

fixes.title: Status replies used the wrong policy
fixes.problem: Searching with the customer's words found the right section 7 of 21 times
fixes.fix: Look the section up by name from the booking's state

fixes.title: Invented services in status replies
fixes.problem: An on-time reply offered 'status alerts' and recited raw JSON
fixes.fix: Plain-language facts, own system prompt, closing line written by code

fixes.title: Replies read like a form
fixes.problem: Answers printed 'Policy answer:' headings and opened with an apology
fixes.fix: Prompt rewritten; the quality gate now checks for headings

fixes.title: Already-resolved booking
fixes.problem: Asking again offered options that no longer existed
fixes.fix: Reply written from the booking record
